info.title: EDUWAY Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the EDUWAY student website, student app and admin portal (contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md v1.0.0).

Envelope: `{ success, data, meta }` / `{ success:false, error:{ code, message, details } }`. Messages are localized via `Accept-Language: en|ar`. Headers: `X-Client-Platform`, `X-Device-Id`, `Idempotency-Key` (payments & critical mutations).

Real-time: the AI tutor streams answers with Server-Sent Events (POST /ai-tutor/conversations/{id}/messages with `Accept: text/event-stream`), falling back to JSON + polling GET /ai-tutor/messages/{messageId}.

post.description: `Accept: text/event-stream` → SSE events `meta` {studentMessage, tutorMessageId, allowance}, `delta` {text}, `done` {message (full text), allowance}, `error` {code, reason, message, allowance}; heartbeat comment every 15 s. Otherwise JSON `{ studentMessage, tutorMessage (pending), allowance, pollAfterMs }` → poll AIT-09. `text` may be empty when `attachmentFileKey` is sent. Pre-stream errors: 402 AI_NOT_INCLUDED, 403 AI_DISABLED / AI_GLOBALLY_DISABLED, 422 AI_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED / AI_BLOCKED_CONTENT, 429 AI_RATE_LIMITED.

200.description: JSON polling payload, or an SSE stream when `Accept: text/event-stream`

schema.description: Server-Sent Events (`Accept: text/event-stream`): `event: meta` {studentMessage, tutorMessageId, allowance} → `event: delta` {text} (append) … → `event: done` {message (FULL text), allowance} or `event: error` {code, reason, message, allowance}. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s.

Transcript (90-day retention) only with `aitutor.approve` or Super Admin; otherwise `[]`.

post.description:
Push goes to Expo tokens of the targeted app platforms (ios/android); in-app rows are written for push + in_app. 422 NO_RECIPIENTS when nobody is reachable.

**Permission:** `notifications.create`

**Idempotency-Key:** required
Header `X-Signature` = hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET (required in every environment). Only deliveries sent through `:provider` are updated.
